summary: This bill nullifies a rule issued by the Environmental Protection Agency that regulates trichloroethylene (TCE) under the Toxic Substances Control Act, preventing it from taking effect.

scores.thoughts: This bill disapproves an EPA rule regulating Trichloroethylene (TCE) under the Toxic Substances Control Act. By nullifying this regulation, the bill would lead to less environmental protection regarding this specific toxic substance, thus pushing towards less environmental regulation.
